definitions.explanation: Serving as a prime example or embodiment of a category; exemplary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代表的|だいひょうてき}な⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Mount Fuji is a representative mountain of Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{代表的|だいひょうてき}な⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is one of the representative examples.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代表的|だいひょうてき}な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Sushi is a representative Japanese dish.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧ (representative) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix)

USAGE:
{代表的|だいひょうてき} emphasizes that something is a prime example or symbol of its category—not just typical, but exemplary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}な⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧: representative example
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}な⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: representative work
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧: representative figure
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: representative dish

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧: representative, symbol
- ⟦{典型的|てんけいてき}→典型的：04801_tenkeiteki⟧: typical, archetypal
